text:
Elena: Quick microcopy check — the CTA in the Dedicated empty state currently says `Enable pool`. Feels vague. Also noticed button contrast looks low on dark mode. Thoughts?
Mike: I think 'Enable pool' is ambiguous. Suggest either 'Enable dedicated GPU pool' or 'Reserve capacity' depending on whether we want short or explicit.
Sam: :eyes: I prefer shorter. 'Reserve capacity' reads clearer as an action. For a11y, button contrast is ~3.8:1 in dark theme — we should aim for 4.5:1 AA.
Elena: Good call. Can we test 'Reserve capacity' vs 'Create dedicated pool'? Also current aria-label is `enable-pool-btn` which is not user-friendly.
Mike: aria-label should be human readable, e.g. 'Reserve dedicated GPU capacity'. Also add aria-describedby linking to the helper copy.
Jae (DevEx Bot): Heads up — copy changes touching CTAs need i18n review. See #eng-internat for localization checklist.
Sam: Another nit: helper text under the CTA says 'Billing will begin on first use' — that's vague. Maybe 'Billing begins when the pool receives traffic' is clearer.
Elena: OK — propose we vet two options for wording + fix contrast/focus:
1) Short: Button = 'Reserve capacity' • Helper = 'Billing begins when pool receives traffic'
2) Explicit: Button = 'Create dedicated pool' • Helper = 'You will be billed for reserved capacity per month'
Mike: Option 1 is cleaner on small widths. Option 2 is explicit about billing cadence. We should probably A/B in the console?
Elena: Accessibility nit — ensure focus ring is visible and not relying on color alone. Also add `aria-describedby` for the helper copy and make helper copy tabbable/readable by screen readers.
Sam: I'll propose a quick CSS + color token change:
```
.button:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); box-shadow: none; }
.button.primary { background-color: var(--redwood-blue-700); color: #fff; }
```
Use `--redwood-blue-700` because it passes 4.5:1 on light/dark.
Mike: For analytics/telemetry, tag the CTA click as `cta:reserve_pool_v2` so we can compare conversions between variants.
Elena: Great. Action items: Sam — update styles + produce screenshots for dark/light mode; Mike — update aria labels + telemetry event; Elena — open i18n thread and coordinate rollout. I'll follow up with a tiny mock. :thumbsup: 
Jae (DevEx Bot): PR checklist reminder: include accessibility labels, aria-describedby, and localization keys. Auto-reminder set for 48h.
Elena: Thanks all — will loop back after PRs land.
